scope: Final source snapshot: directed0D queue/Update/messages/live effects and default source-issued commander grant. Actual EVT loader and message helper comparisons, fresh-definition CP949 startup binding, and source-current client/API audit. Overlapping assertions/reports are never added together.

scenario-progress.scope: Source script/event parser, original MRC mutation, isolated managed entry/approved clear/outro/result/return, save/reconnect and refusal. Includes source-issued local-server commander grants, atomic receipts/acknowledgements and source base/first-level profile fixtures. Not 97 combat clears, original server grant-level policy, or Unity Play.

native-directed-event.scope: Production raw5C0D ingress, FIFO, script magic/lifecycle and default local-server source-issued recruit processing. Explicit supplied unit/team/eligibility fixtures; no invented server trigger conditions.

native-directed-frame.scope: Original GameCtl Update/10F20 against production CampaignPresentation native mode for the whitelist-supported EVT bodies, four supplied ownership/random contexts and explicit movement/timer controls. Compare next line, active/execution/test flags, emitted request bytes, map/profile calls and exact MAGIC/KILL export arguments after each Update. MAGIC target query supplies no target; KILL exports are captured boundaries, not executed here. MFC message helper, audio backend, map mutator, profile provider and transport are supplied boundaries. A dismissal acknowledges the whole message; this does not verify page rendering, physical clicks, trigger policy or real FPS.

native-directed-control.scope: Actual GameCtl mode1 MAGIC dispatcher, CheckMagicTarget supplied capsule, native E4C0 and captured Magic import. Native request bytes compare with four production0D ingress/service fixtures; mode gating and request-before-effect order are observed. Actual UserUnit dmKillChar/dmKillChar2 exports execute over explicit runtime/grid records, including negative IDs, corpse flag and unchanged HP/AP. MFC strings/allocation and grid writes are boundaries. Not a server trigger, damage, XP, death-to-ghost or Unity rendering proof.

native-directed-input.scope: Extracted production pointer acknowledgement and cutscene predicate with real CampaignPresentation pages, supplied Unity frame clock and transport. Not actual UGUI raycasts, keyboard or OS clicks.

native-campaign-message.scope: Actual GameCtl109E0/10810 parsing/alias calls and actual supplied MFC42/CRT ANSI Format in explicit C-locale image state. All unique source MESSAGE forms plus COM0..9/ME/ID/literal/two-argument/percent controls, mixed CP949/ASCII three-byte prefixes and native one-byte COM suffix atoi-to-zero controls. Roster, current team name and CString allocation/window creation are supplied; subject7 does not select the ME name. Safe %s/%% results and portrait job match production resolver. Source %S uses a wide pointer; production reproduces its bounded C-locale empty/single-ASCII conversion rather than normalize it to %s or read beyond an ANSI allocation. No Windows locale initialization, unsafe overread, original process/page rendering or Unity Play equivalence is claimed.

native-message-substring.scope: Actual exact supplied MFC42 Left4129/Mid4278 count/clamp/offset paths. Mixed CP949/ASCII aliases prove three bytes and one suffix byte, including split multibyte characters. AllocCopy/empty construction and atomic refcounts are supplied boundaries; no DLL startup, real allocator, OS locale initialization or rendered text claim.

native-event-loader.scope: Actual13D60/F110/F310/F040 executes over all112 decoded source EVT files. Production parser is compiled unchanged and compared by active event ID and ordered body through first END. Includes zero/duplicate/nested headers, literal case/space tokens, full decimal conditions, blank/999 disabling, 99 action slots and EOF; failed extraction/open clears old flags. CString storage and decoded file/archive callbacks are supplied; not actual archive extraction, server condition evaluation or Unity Play.

native-event-corpus.scope: Actual10F20 on every production-parsed repository EVT body for supplied local-team rand0/rand100 and foreign-team rand0; every emitted request compared to production packet bytes at the exact native line/TEST/owner state. Timers are advanced and user dismissal is supplied. MESSAGE helper, kill helper, no-target magic check, map geometry, MFC/graphics/profile/transport/audio/units/allocation remain explicit boundaries. Transcript control/requests only: not all indirect callees, original0D loader/FIFO integration, server conditions/awards, actual playback, input, original FPS or current Unity frame equivalence.

native-evidence-manifest.scope: Declared native exports preserve their recorded bytes; all referenced native/managed reports match current declared source hashes and manifest pointers;0D/15/61/68 bridge flags agree with the current common route inventory;B2 remains unconnected. Directed-event tests retain their explicit team, target, formatting and input boundaries. This audits existing successful evidence and does not rerun it or establish whole-client/Unity/Windows equivalence.

native-evidence-refresh-guard.scope: Actual metadata refresh over isolated manifest copies. Current report/source verification, exact reference-only changes, and no partial writes on late bad evidence/retarget refusal. No game files or original evidence are mutated.

limits: No actual Unity Play/Test Runner/OS input/audio listening; SDK/API/native bounded execution only.
Original Windows first warehouse reconnect failure remains unresolved and preserved.
Original server event triggers, full delivery order and undefined costs/awards are not inferred.
Default new recruit level1/XP0/class-name/deployment2 is an explicit local policy; source stats and level1 learned abilities are used.
Native end preemption, remaining unconnected common routes and original process/locale initialization are not claimed complete.
